unmapped: Applicants must have had smallpox; miners, soldiers, seamen, watchmen and militia members are barred (health and occupation exclusions).
No one may belong to another benefit society (exclusion of a whole class of other bodies, not named organisations).
A member impressed or balloted into a barred trade may rejoin without a fee if healthy and applying within three months of discharge.

The member declares sickness at the house; the landlord tells the stewards within 12 hours; the stewards visit within 24 hours if within three miles and may advance up to 3s (a claims procedure with deadlines and an advance).

Sick pay is cut to 3s 6d a week when the member can earn no more than half his former wage, confirmed by his apothecary and neighbours; light work allowed under that limit (benefit scaled to residual earnings).
A relapse within ten days of a declared recovery, before six months, joins the periods (benefit continuity rule).
The president and stewards attend a funeral within three miles and receive 1s 6d each.
Death benefit is paid at the first month-night after the death, free of deductions.
A surplus from the feast dinner is returned to each member in the liquor he prefers.
notes: Articles 1 and 6-10 (and any amendment rule) are not in the summarised text. £ amounts converted at 240d to the pound; 1s 6d etc. as written.
